title: What Garage Organization Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of garage organization: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Garages become black holes without zones: park, tools, sports, seasonal, trash/recycling. Sort everything, zone the walls, and get it off the floor.

Why it matters: Zone the garage: 5 zones max Wall storage (pegboard, slats) frees floor space

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Garage Organization
summary: Start garage organization this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Empty one zone at a time
2. Sort: keep/donate/trash
3. Sweep and check for pests/moisture
4. Install wall storage first
5. Assign every zone a boundary

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.
facts: Empty one zone at a time

title: Common Garage Organization Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
summary: The mistakes everyone makes with garage organization — and the fixes.
body:
The classic errors:

- Buying bins before purging → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- No zones - everything migrates → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Storing paint/chemicals badly → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Blocking the electrical panel → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.

Every mistake above is cheap to prevent and expensive to repair. Prevention is the whole game.
